title: Create missing QA Gate labels (qa-pass, author-pass, i18n-pass)
description: qa-gate.yml requires labels qa-pass, author-pass, and i18n-pass to pass, but the repo only has labels: ci-pass, merge-conflict, queue. The QA Gate check will always fail because the required labels do not exist in the repo. Create the three missing labels via Forgejo API.
acceptance_criteria: Labels qa-pass, author-pass, and i18n-pass exist in the Forgejo repo. QA Gate workflow can pass when all three labels are applied to a PR.

title: Test: /remind route encodes title and returns redirect HTML
description: Verify /remind/<title> percent-encodes the title, builds correct x-apple-reminderkit://REMCDReminder/<title> URI, returns redirect HTML. Test empty/missing title returns 400 error response.

title: Test: /raw route decodes base64url and redirects
description: Verify /raw/<base64url> correctly decodes base64url (with - and _ substitution) to the original URI and returns redirect HTML. Test that invalid base64 returns 400 error response.

title: Upgrade vitest from v3 to v4
description: vitest 3.2.4 is installed but 4.1.0 is available (major version bump). Upgrade vitest in package.json to ^4.0.0, run npm install, verify all 12 tests still pass. Check for any breaking changes in the vitest v4 changelog.
acceptance_criteria: package.json specifies vitest ^4.0.0. npm install succeeds. All 12 existing tests pass.

title: Merge unmerged feature branch and clean up stale branches
description: The repo is checked out on claude/add-jsdoc-annotations which has 2 commits (JSDoc annotations + lang=en attributes) not merged to develop. No open PR exists. Additionally, 3 stale local branches remain: claude/ci-and-tests, claude/initial-routes, eva/add-html-lang-attr. Create PR for unmerged work, then delete all stale local branches after merge.
acceptance_criteria: All work from claude/add-jsdoc-annotations is merged to develop. All stale local feature branches are deleted. Local checkout is on develop.

title: Dependency audit: check for vulnerable packages
description: Run npm audit on current dependencies (vitest and any transitive deps). Fix or document any high/critical vulnerabilities. Add npm audit --audit-level=high step to CI workflow so future vulns fail the build.

title: Add CLAUDE.md with project conventions and commands
description: No CLAUDE.md exists. Create one documenting: project purpose (CF Workers URL shortener/redirect + key vault), tech stack (JS, Cloudflare Workers, Vitest), directory layout (src/worker.js is source, dist/_worker.js is deploy artifact), commands (npm test, wrangler deploy), CI setup, and branch conventions.
acceptance_criteria: CLAUDE.md exists at repo root with accurate project description, build/test/deploy commands, and architecture notes.

title: Test: /cal route converts date to epoch and builds calshow: URI
description: Verify /cal/YYYY-MM-DD produces correct Unix epoch in calshow: URI. Test date+time variant /cal/YYYY-MM-DD/HH:MM. Test invalid date format returns 400. Test edge cases: leap years, end-of-month dates.

title: Security: no secrets in source code audit
description: Scan src/ for hardcoded secrets: API keys, tokens, KV namespace IDs, UUIDs that look like credentials. Verify wrangler.toml KV namespace ID is safe to be public (it is a binding reference, not a credential). Add trufflehog or similar to CI.

title: Test: KV read error in /key route handled gracefully
description: Mock env.VAULT.get to throw an exception. Verify the worker returns a safe error response rather than propagating an unhandled rejection. Same for env.VAULT.put throwing on POST. Worker must never expose a raw stack trace to the client.

title: Test: /obs route returns redirect HTML with correct obsidian:// URI
description: Verify /obs/<vault>/<path> constructs correct obsidian://open?vault=&file= URI, returns 200 HTML with meta refresh and JS redirect. Test URL encoding edge cases: spaces, slashes, Unicode in path segments. Test missing file path segment returns 400.

title: Test: /key POST stores value in VAULT and deletes token
description: Mock env.VAULT.put and env.VAULT.delete. Verify POST with valid value stores vault:<keyName> with 300s TTL, deletes token:<token>, returns success page. Verify POST with empty value returns form with error message. Verify unexpected methods return 400.

title: Enable CI status check enforcement in branch protection
description: Branch protection on develop has enable_status_check=false and status_check_contexts=null. CI runs on PRs but a failing CI does not block merge. PATCH the branch protection to set enable_status_check=true and status_check_contexts to the CI job name so PRs with failing tests cannot be merged.
acceptance_criteria: Branch protection has enable_status_check=true. A PR with a failing CI check cannot be merged.

title: Add unit tests for escapeHtml and escapeAttr XSS functions
description: escapeHtml and escapeAttr in src/worker.js are security-critical functions that prevent XSS injection, but they have no direct unit tests. They need to be exported or tested indirectly with payloads containing <, >, &, quotes, and single quotes to verify proper escaping in redirect pages and key vault forms.
acceptance_criteria: Tests verify that HTML special characters in user-controlled inputs (vault paths, reminder titles, key names) are properly escaped in response HTML. At least 3 test cases covering angle brackets, quotes, and ampersands.

title: Test: /remind route encodes title and builds correct x-apple-reminderkit URI
description: Verify /remind/<title> percent-encodes the title correctly, returns redirect HTML, and returns 400 when title is empty/missing.

title: Document all route endpoints with request/response examples
description: Create docs/routes.md covering every route: method, path pattern, path parameters, success response (status + headers + body summary), error conditions and status codes. Include curl examples for each. This is the contract doc for the worker API.

title: Security: add X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, CSP headers to all responses
description: All responses (redirect pages, key vault, usage page, error responses) should include: X-Frame-Options: DENY, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Referrer-Policy: no-referrer, Content-Security-Policy (restrict inline scripts — note current JS redirect uses inline script, may need nonce or hash). Add tests to verify headers present.

title: Test: unknown routes return 400 with descriptive error
description: Verify requests to unrecognized paths (e.g. /foo, /bar/baz) return 400 text/plain response with the unknown route message. Confirm root / returns 200 usage HTML, not 400.

title: Add CI build step to sync dist/_worker.js from src/worker.js
description: dist/_worker.js is out of sync with src/worker.js. The dist version is missing JSDoc annotations and lang=en attributes present in src. No build pipeline exists — the dist file was manually placed. Add a CI step or build script that copies/transforms src/worker.js into dist/_worker.js, and a CI check that fails if they diverge.
acceptance_criteria: CI fails when dist/_worker.js differs from src/worker.js. A script or build step keeps them in sync.

title: Performance benchmark: measure P99 response latency under load with wrangler
description: Use wrangler dev + a load testing tool (autocannon or k6) to benchmark all routes locally. Capture P50/P95/P99 latency. Establish baselines. The /key route involves KV reads — simulate latency there. Document results in docs/performance.md.

title: Add security headers to all HTTP responses
description: A previous bead (Security: add X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, CSP headers) was closed but no security headers exist in src/worker.js. All responses (redirectPage, usagePage, errorResponse, keyFormPage, keyExpiredPage, keySuccessPage) lack X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, and Content-Security-Policy headers. Add a shared headers helper or wrap Response construction to include these on every response.
acceptance_criteria: All responses include X-Frame-Options: DENY, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, and a restrictive Content-Security-Policy. Tests verify headers are present.

title: Test: /key GET returns form when token valid, 404 when expired
description: Mock env.VAULT.get: when token exists GET returns 200 form page with key name. When token missing/expired returns 404 expired page. Verify form displays correct key name label (dashes to title case).

title: Test: /obs route returns redirect page with correct obsidian:// URI
description: Verify /obs/<vault>/<path> constructs the correct obsidian://open?vault=&file= URI, returns 200 HTML with meta refresh, and handles URL encoding edge cases (spaces, slashes, Unicode in path segments).

title: Unit tests: route handler coverage overview
description: Audit all route handlers (obs, remind, cal, raw, key) and ensure each has dedicated unit test files in src/worker.test.js. Map test coverage gaps and fill them.

title: Unit tests: route handler coverage overview
description: Audit all route handlers (obs, remind, cal, raw, key, root) and ensure each has dedicated unit tests in src/worker.test.js. Map coverage gaps and fill them. Use vitest (already configured).

title: Add CODEOWNERS file to auto-request qa reviews
description: Branch protection has block_on_official_review_requests=true and approvals_whitelist_username=[qa], but no CODEOWNERS file exists. Without CODEOWNERS, qa is never auto-requested as reviewer. Add CODEOWNERS with '* @qa' to match the convention in other repos (e.g. DeskDays).
acceptance_criteria: CODEOWNERS file exists with '* @qa'. New PRs automatically request review from qa user.

title: Return 405 Method Not Allowed for unsupported HTTP methods on /key/
description: In handleKeyVault (src/worker.js line 281), requests with methods other than GET/POST return errorResponse('Method not allowed.') which sends a 400 Bad Request. The correct HTTP status for this is 405 Method Not Allowed with an Allow header listing GET, POST. Change errorResponse call to use status 405 and add Allow header.
acceptance_criteria: PUT/DELETE/PATCH to /key/<valid-token> returns 405 with Allow: GET, POST header. Test verifies this.

title: Add JSDoc type annotations to all exported functions and handlers
description: Add JSDoc @param and @returns annotations to fetch handler, all route handlers, and helper functions (redirectPage, errorResponse, escapeHtml, escapeAttr, handleKeyVault, etc.). Enables IDE autocomplete and catches type mismatches without full TypeScript migration. Optionally wire up tsc --checkJs --noEmit in CI.

title: Test: /raw route decodes base64url and returns redirect HTML
description: Verify /raw/<base64url> correctly decodes base64url (- and _ substitution for + and /) to the original URI and returns redirect HTML. Verify invalid base64 input returns 400 error response.

title: Test: special characters in path segments handled safely
description: Test routes with special characters in path segments: %, &, =, #, <, >, quotes. Verify escapeHtml and escapeAttr functions prevent XSS in generated HTML. Specifically test that user-controlled path data cannot inject script tags or break attribute quoting.

title: Test: /cal route converts date to epoch and builds calshow: URI
description: Verify /cal/YYYY-MM-DD produces correct Unix epoch in calshow: URI. Test /cal/YYYY-MM-DD/HH:MM variant. Test invalid formats return 400. Edge cases: leap year dates, end-of-month, timezone assumptions.

title: Test: very long path segments handled without crash
description: Test all routes with path segments at 1KB, 10KB, and 100KB. Worker should return a valid response (error or redirect) rather than throwing. Confirm no unhandled exceptions on oversized inputs.

title: Add test for key vault POST submission flow
description: Tests cover key vault GET (shows form) and expired token (404), but there is no test for the POST submission flow in src/worker.test.js. The POST handler parses formData, validates value, stores in VAULT with TTL, and deletes the token. All of this is untested. Add tests for: (1) successful POST stores value and deletes token, (2) POST with empty value shows error, (3) POST to expired token returns 404.
acceptance_criteria: Three new tests in /key/ vault describe block: successful POST, empty value POST, expired token POST. All pass.
